issue.detail: Spec says load with train_history concatenated with train_taken, but does not specify bit order: is train_taken the new LSB (history = {train_history[30:0], train_taken}) or MSB? Rule assumes LSB (shift left, insert at bit 0). Alternative: train_taken becomes MSB (history = {train_taken, train_history[31:1]}). Distinguishing sequence: train_history=1, train_taken=1, train_mispredicted=1 -> LSB gives 3, MSB gives 0x80000001.
issue.spec_evidence: This is the history before the mispredicted branch (train_history) concatenated with the actual result of the branch (train_taken).
issue.alternative: Concatenate train_taken as the most significant bit: new history = {train_taken, train_history[31:1]}.

issue.detail: Spec says shift in predict_taken from LSB side, but does not explicitly state shift direction (left vs right) or whether predict_taken becomes new bit 0. Rule assumes left shift with predict_taken as new LSB. Alternative: right shift with predict_taken as new MSB (history = {predict_taken, history[31:1]}). Distinguishing sequence: start history=1, predict_taken=1 -> left shift gives 3, right shift gives 0x80000001.
issue.spec_evidence: shift in predict_taken from the LSB side to update the branch history for the predicted branch. (predict_history[0] is the direction of the youngest branch.)
issue.alternative: Shift right and insert predict_taken at MSB: new history = {predict_taken, history[31:1]}.
